svg.aria-label: Height over time in two flights of the same star. Flown fast, the height the app calculated matches the ground sensor to within about 17 centimetres. Flown slowly, the app is about 1.3 metres off at the top.
svg.text: Flown fast: the app and the sensor agree
The same star, about 25 s. Gap at most 0.17 m
Flown slowly: the app loses track
The same star, about 92 s. Gap about 1.3 m at the top
